title: ‘Odyssey’ director Christopher Nolan calls AI an obvious ‘Trojan horse’
slides: Why does Nolan call AI a Trojan horse?
He warns it hides deeper societal control.
The real threat isn't AI's power—its blind adoption.
You must question every automated decision system.
Resist by auditing tools before trusting them.
thread_text:
1. Why call AI a Trojan horse?

Nolan used the myth of a hidden army. The real invasion isn’t code—it’s the quiet loss of your autonomy.

2. The danger isn’t rebellion

The machines won’t revolt. The risk is you handing over decisions to systems you don’t understand.

3. Adoption blinds you

People race to integrate AI tools without audits. Speed becomes a trap that locks in biases.

4. Question every automated decision

Defaulting to AI scores your loan, job, and freedom. You never see the logic behind the result.

5. Audit before you trust

Take one tool you use daily. Run a test with skewed inputs. If you haven’t done it, start tonight.

instagram.caption:
Christopher Nolan just called AI a “Trojan horse”—it’s not the machines rising up, it’s you quietly handing over control.  

Nolan warns the real invasion is blind adoption, not rebellion. People race to integrate AI tools without audits, and speed locks in hidden biases. You never see the logic when AI decides your loan or job.  

If you create content or use automated tools, your autonomy is the cost. You can’t outsource accountability to a black box.  

Take one tool you use daily. Run a test with skewed inputs tonight. ⚡️🧠🕵️‍♂️
